scope: Targeted dental geometry and material review in the actual MUSE browser application. Expression preset refinement is reviewed separately.
findings: The licensed source contains 32 separate enamel crowns and a larger gingiva/oral-lining component.
Original lower central crowns measured 9.28 mm high in the baked character; upper central crowns measured 11.22 mm.
Lip stretch, smile and funnel targets already leave dental geometry rigid; the existing jaw targets move the lower row.
The old lower-crown height and flat coarse incisal contours made the lower row dominate fear and surprise.
repairs: Anterior lower crowns resized to 80% of original height about their root; posterior crowns blend toward 96%, preserving the existing dental arch.
Upper anterior crowns receive only a 2% height adjustment; the original relative tooth widths and row projection remain.
One restrained subdivision pass rounds crown corners and reduces facets while keeping each tooth separate.
Jaw-target deltas are transported through the local crown deformation, then normals are regenerated for the refined base and live targets.
Warm ivory enamel #d7cdbc with roughness .30 and specular intensity .36 replaces the glaring white appearance; stain suppression and distinct gum color remain.

verification.syntax: node --check passed for dentition.mjs and materials.mjs
verification.sourceAsset: CC0 source GLB bytes unchanged; refinement runs after fixed facial identity and contour baking

observations: Lower crowns are visibly less prominent with softer incisal edges. The upper smile row stays attached and retains distinct teeth.
Reviewed front, three-quarter and profile views show no new tooth/lip crossing or floating crown.
Receiving directional shadows was tested and rejected because it caused grainy dark speckles on enamel.
Surprise still needed a separate small oral-pose adjustment to expose a balanced upper/lower row; that work belongs to the expression adapter.
limits: Before/after images include the concurrently refined shared facial contour; they are integrated application evidence, not an isolated dental-only beauty comparison.
All eight loops were sampled numerically; visual dental inspection concentrated on fear, surprise and laughter at peak from three angles.
This is illustrative realtime dentition, not a dental reconstruction or medically validated occlusion model.
Geometry counts, finite buffers and exact loop closure do not certify artistic quality.

expressionCaptureProvenance.scope: Dental numerical checks and closeups captured before the subsequent lip-only fear/surprise refinement. Final integrated expression evidence is in qa/expressions/checks.json, playback.json and art-review.json.
